intro: Night work keeps its own hour, the stretch after the doors lock and before morning will admit you. If that hour is yours in Houston, this page is the short dark you can take into the car. Pump Six is told by an overnight clerk who watches a black sedan stop at a pump and never buy gas. It is companion fiction from the world of The Ryan Kane Series. It is not a chapter of HUNTED, and the series is not set in Texas. The story does not name Houston, and this page will not pretend that it does. What belongs here is the offer to a reader who is already tired: four minutes of dread, then the prequel if the sedan will not leave your mind. HUNTED is free on BookFunnel. The novel after that prequel, Fractured Ground, is the Kindle edition. Anyone who wants book three before a wide release can request Digital Ascent from BookSprout. Pump Six keeps a separate home on its free-read page, so this Houston URL can stay about the reader, not about a map. Sit with the clerk. Leave with the longer book when you want it.
